name: Rot13withcasepreservation

description_json.name: Rot13WithCasePreservation
description_json.idea: A simple, highly intuitive Caesar-style cipher with a fixed shift of 13. Each letter is rotated by 13 positions in the alphabet. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged. This is extremely easy for LLMs to reason about while completely altering the token representation.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it by 13 positions: encrypt(char) = (char - 'A' + 13) % 26 + 'A'.
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it by 13 positions: encrypt(char) = (char - 'a' + 13) % 26 + 'a'.
3. If it is any other character (space, digit, punctuation), leave it unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it back by 13 positions: decrypt(char) = (char - 'A' - 13) % 26 + 'A'. (Since 13 is half of 26, decryption is identical to encryption).
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it back by 13 positions: decrypt(char) = (char - 'a' - 13) % 26 + 'a'.
3. If it is any other character, leave it unchanged.
